name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.

changes.title: What Cyclospora does inside the gut and how it gets there
changes.summary: Cyclospora , the parasite that has sickened thousands this summer in the U.S., requires time in the human digestive tract to reproduce. (Image credit: wildpixel).

changes.title: U.S. Restores Some Vaccine and Health Aid to Unicef, Gavi and World Food Programme
changes.summary: The amount is still far below what the U.S. spent previously on humanitarian and health aid, but resumes the flow of money for key efforts to fight malnutrition and disease.

changes.title: Can Democratic Socialists Agree on Anything? They Say That’s Not the Point.
changes.summary: At a national summit of the Democratic Socialists of America, nervous energy and a sprawling tableau of sometimes-competing interests were on display.

changes.title: Trump Blasts Jeanine Pirro’s Move to Drop Reflecting Pool Charges
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is criticizing his handpicked choice for U.S. attorney in D.C., Jeanine Pirro, for dropping charges against the former Olympian accused of vandalizing the reflecting pool. Meanwhile, the president said he will continue to push for an “anti-weaponization fund” if the senate does not confirm Todd B.

changes.title: Rep. Turner says infrastructure should be "hardened" as U.S. probes water cyberattack
changes.summary: GOP Rep. Mike Turner of Ohio said critical infrastructure assets "need to be hardened" as investigators are probing whether Iranian hackers are behind malicious cyber activity that affected technology at water systems in U.S. states last week.

changes.title: Fact-checking Trump's claims about how the Iran war is going
changes.summary: Even as a ceasefire was crumbling, leading the U.S. to wage new attacks on Iran, President Donald Trump touted the United States' war as a success.

changes.title: Climate change could dramatically reduce water flowing from the West's headwaters
changes.summary: The small mountain streams that feed many of the West's rivers may face a much drier future. A new study led by NAU researchers found that groundwater-fed streamflow, known as base flow, has been steadily declining across headwater watersheds in the western United States since 1950 and could decrease by 45% to 65% by t.

changes.title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
changes.summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.

changes.title: Trump says he's cancelling Iran strikes, deal pending
changes.summary: Trump said Iran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked the U.S. "to hold off any attack" on Iran because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to." (Image credit: Jacquelyn Martin).
